site_hero_title: Offline terminology retrieval you can audit
site_hero_subtitle: Search ICD-10, ATC, LOINC, HCPCS, and related coding systems on-device — with explainable match scores, multilingual UI, and reproducible benchmarks.
site_panel_title: Built for reference, not clinical decision support
site_panel_body: MedCode Clinical returns stored terminology entries only. Every result shows how it matched — exact, prefix, substring, fuzzy, or alias expansion.
site_feature_explain_body: Each result exposes a normalized score and matchMethod — no black-box relevance model.
site_feature_offline_body: Vocabularies bundle on-device via SQLite. Search does not call external APIs by default.
site_feature_multi_body: Switch schemes or search across ICD, drugs, labs, procedures, and supplies in one workflow.
